value.rationale: Degree and betweenness are canonical competing notions of network importance. The smallest connected graph where each measure makes an unambiguous but different choice of most-central actor is therefore a natural structural boundary, and the fact that its entire first layer is one asymmetric isomorphism type gives a concise benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
